title: Open-Faced Cheddar Tuna Melts with Dill Pickles
summary: Tuna is mixed with mayonnaise, pickles, red onion, celery, lemon and dill, spread on butter-toasted sourdough, heaped with Cheddar and grilled 3-4 minutes until bubbling and browned.

ingredients.item: x 145 g cans tuna in olive oil, well drained
thick slices sourdough or white bloomer (about 180 g)

steps.title: Make the tuna salad
steps.text: Flake the tuna and mix in the mayonnaise, pickles, onion, celery, lemon, mustard powder, dill and pepper.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.text: Heat the grill to high with a rack 10 cm below.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.text: Butter one side of each slice and toast both sides under the grill until golden.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Spread the tuna salad to the edges and pile on the cheese.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Grill 3-4 minutes until the cheese bubbles and browns in spots.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest 1 minute and serve with pickle spears.

tips: Drain the tuna well or the toast turns soggy.
Spread the tuna right to the edges so the corners do not burn.
Watch closely at the end; grills vary a lot.
storage: Best eaten hot. Keep leftover tuna salad chilled for up to 2 days and make fresh melts. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
